note: Generated by design/tools/boss_horizon.py. World units. The Well has no hull: it is a black disc, a photon ring, three rings of dashes and a meter; everything else is rules.

numbers.contact: the horizon takes a Shield cell and throws the ship 300 wu outward; nothing else about the Well touches

pull.rule: everything inside the range accelerates toward the Well: speed toward it = max x (photonRadius / distance) ^ 1.2, added to its own motion
pull.note: the ship flies at 520, so it can always leave; a Dash ignores the pull. Player shots bend: aim ahead of the curve. The lattice is pulled with a standing impulse of 400 at the horizon, falling off the same way

feeding.lanes: spiral arms that start 1,300 wu out and wind 270 degrees into the Well; the director's whole crowd for this fight arrives along them, fodder only
feeding.eaten: a body that crosses the horizon is eaten: no Shards, no score, one cell on the meal meter. Five uncollected Shards that cross it count as one body

meter.note: an arc of cells round the photon ring, filling clockwise in the danger colour as it eats; emptied on every bar line

barLine.rule: on every bar line the Well looks at its meal. Fed (the meal reached the phase's hunger): it erupts and its shield holds for the bar. Starved (it did not): it gasps, and for the whole next bar it takes full damage

eruption.pattern: spiral arms: as many arms as there are lanes, the bullets leaving one per sixteenth along each arm, each arm turning 12 degrees per bullet
eruption.note: its bullets are pulled too: slow ones curl back and are eaten, without filling the meter

gasp.note: the rings thin to a third, the horizon's rim turns gold, the core shows: a gold four-point star, the weak point

phases.name: Accretion
phases.note: two lanes, opposite each other: one player can hold both by circling

phases.name: Tidal

wave.note: a ring leaves the Well at 600 wu/s and shoves ships and Shards 140 wu outward as it passes; it does no damage, it breaks your position

phases.note: three lanes: no place covers them all, so the meal is decided by where you stand when the bar ends

phases.name: Collapse

jets.note: two opposite beams along the Well's axis, shown as danger dashes for the bar before; the axis turns 45 degrees every bar

phases.note: four lanes and the Well comes for you; starving it now takes the whole build

camera.note: eased over the entrance bar; the Well is kept in the frame as for every boss

music.drone: a sub sine on the Track's root that sinks a semitone for every three cells on the meter and springs back on the bar line
music.eaten: each body eaten plays the next note of the Track's arp an octave down, bending down a fifth: you hear the meal being counted
music.eruption: the impact and the gong on the bar line, the louder the bigger the meal
music.gasp: the pads and the bass cut out for the first beat of a starved bar under a reversed cymbal: that silence is the signal to attack
music.tidalWave: the riser's last half-beat into beat 3

look.black: the disc inside the horizon is drawn last and is true black: no bloom, no afterglow, no grid. It is the only black thing in the game
look.rings: three rings of dashes in the Track's three enemy hues, each turning at its own rate; the side turning toward the camera's right is 1.8x brighter than the other, so the disc looks tilted and alive
look.photon: one white line round the horizon, 2 px; gold while starved
look.meter: twelve cells just outside the photon ring in the danger colour; the cell being filled flashes white
look.lens: the lattice bends into the Well; lines that cross the horizon stop at it
look.trails: everything on a lane leaves a trail in its own hue, so the lanes read as spiral arms of light

numbers.entrance: on the Drop's downbeat every light on screen leans toward one point and the grid pinches there over two beats; the disc opens black on beat 3 and the rings spin up over the rest of the bar; the name card EVENT HORIZON holds for two bars
numbers.death: it implodes: for one bar everything left alive, every bullet, every spark and the lattice itself spiral into a point and the music thins to the drone alone; one beat of black and silence; then the clamped white flash on the downbeat, three rings, 400 sparks in the Track's hues, the 30 px distortion ring, 50 ms hit-stop, and everything it ate comes back as Shards: 300 in a fountain
numbers.coop: health x (1 + 0.5 x (players - 1)); hunger +2 per extra player; lanes are spread evenly whatever the player count, so a team covers them by splitting up
